others.resetFactoryDesc: Gusubiramo porogaramu mu buryo bwa mbere, ugasiba amashusho yose n'inyandiko y'ikiganiro. iyi Igikorwa ni itarasubiramo kandi ni byiza gusa niba porogaramu yahinduwe.

shortcuts.switchAssistantDesc: Igenda ku mukoresha ukurikira mu kiganiro.

interface.subtitle: Ukore Novera yawe, kuva ku isura yayo kugeza ku mikorere yawe y'ikiganiro.
interface.accentColorDesc: Guhitamo ibara ry'umugaragaro n'ibara rya sidebar.
interface.title: Imigaragarire
interface.notificationPositionDesc: ku Windows, i Mburabuzi ni i Hasi: iburyo kugirango i popups OYA Gufunga i Igenzura idirishya
interface.showTokenSpeedDesc: Kugaragaza tokens/sec na token count inline munsi y'amabaruwa y'umufasha. Niba yahagaritswe, ikosa ry'icyerekezo rigaragaza iby'ibanze ku rubuga.
interface.coloredUserBubbleDesc: Gukoresha ibara ry'umurongo nk'inyuma y'amabaruwa yawe. Niba bihagaritswe, ibara ry'umurongo rihuza amabaruwa y'umukoresha n'amabaruwa y'umukoresha ku ibara ry'inyuma ridasanzwe.
interface.renderHtmlArtifactsDesc: Kongeramo tab y'Igaragazambere ku HTML na SVG ibice by'inyandikoporogaramu. HTML ikoresha ipaji igenerwa n'ubwoko mu ishusho ya sandbox ikoresha inyandikorugero zayo ariko idashobora kugera kuri Novera, inyandiko zawe, cyangwa urubuga; SVG ikoresha inyandikorugero zihagaritswe. Ihagaritswe ku buryo busanzwe.
interface.primaryDesc: Gushyiraho ibara rya mbere ry'amabara y'imigaragarire.
interface.accentDesc: Guhitamo ibara ry'umugaragaro rikoreshwa mu UI.
interface.destructiveDesc: Gushyiraho ibara ry'igaragaza cyane ry'ibikorwa byangiza.
interface.resetToDefaultDesc: Gusubiramo amagenamiterere yose y'uburyo bw'ikoranabuhanga ku bisanzwe.
interface.resetInterfaceSuccessDesc: Amagenamiterere yose ya interineti yahinduwe ku buryo busanzwe.
interface.threadScrollDesc: Guhitamo uko idirishya ry'ikiganiro rigomba kwitwara igihe hageze amabaruwa mashya.
interface.threadScrollFlowHint: Gushyira idirishya ry'uburyo bwo gusoma ku butumwa rwa nyuma washyizeho.
interface.threadScrollStickyHint: Ibisubizo bigenda bikurikiranya mu buryo bwihuse kandi mu gihe cyagutse.
interface.tokenCounterCompactDesc: Kugaragaza umubare w'amatoke mu nyandiko y'ikiganiro. Nubwo bihagaritswe, umubare w'amatoke ugaragara munsi y'inyandiko y'ikiganiro.
interface.showLineNumbersDesc: Kugaragaza imibare y'imirongo mu bice by'inyandiko.
interface.resetCodeBlockSuccessDesc: Imisusire y'igice cy'inyandiko yahinduwe ku buryo busanzwe.

hardware.name: Name=Ikigo cy' ikoranabuhanga
hardware.enableVulkanDesc: Koresha Vulkan API kugirango acceleration GPU. OYA Hagatisha Vulkan NIBA ufite a NVIDIA GPU Nka Bishobora gutuma ibibazo by'ubuziranenge.
hardware.noDevicesDesc: Nta GPUs zigaragara ku murongo llama.cpp. Imisusire izakora ku CPU.
hardware.backendSelectDesc: Ukoresha iyi API kuri iyi GPU
hardware.unifiedMemoryDesc: GPU ifatira ikirere kimwe n'CPU — ibimodeli bivamo mu memory y'umwihariko nk'ibindi by'umubara.
hardware.engineRestartedForDevices: GPU zawe zahinduwe, bityo engine yo mu rugo yasubukuwe. Amamodoka asubiramo mu gihe cy'ikoreshwa rikurikira.
hardware.engineBusyDevicesChanged: GPU zawe zahinduwe, ariko umwe mu mamodoka ni asanzwe. Guhagarika, hanyuma ukanda Refresh kugirango ukoreshe ishya GPU.

httpsProxy.proxyUrlDesc: URL na port ya proxy server yawe.
httpsProxy.authenticationDesc: Indangakintu za seriveri ya proxy, niba ari ngombwa.
httpsProxy.noProxyDesc: Urutonde rw'amadirishya atandukanye n'amakomatanya kugirango uhindure i porogisi.
httpsProxy.ignoreSslDesc: Kwemera impamyabushobozi zifite inyandikonyakwirema cyangwa zitavuguruwe. Bishobora kuba bikenewe ku bundi burenganzira bw' umukoresha, ariko bigabanya umutekano. Hitamo iyi niba wizera uwo mukoresha.
httpsProxy.proxySslDesc: Gusuzuma niba icyemezo SSL gifite ishingiro mu guhuza na porogisi.
httpsProxy.proxyHostSslDesc: Gusuzuma niba icyemezo SSL cy'umukoresha wa porogisi gifite ishingiro.
httpsProxy.peerSslDesc: Gusuzuma niba impamyabushobozi SSL z'itumanaho ry'abafatanyabikorwa ari nziza.
httpsProxy.hostSslDesc: Gusuzuma niba impamyabushobozi SSL z'amadirishya y'icyerekezo ari nziza.

webSearch.title: Gushakisha ku mbuga nkoranyambaga
webSearch.description: Reka abagore n'abagabo gushakisha no gusoma urubuga rukoresha Novera's built-in tools.
webSearch.enableDesc: Gutangaza i web_search na web_fetch ibikoresho ku mamodoka ashyigikiye ikoreshwa ry'ibikoresho. Ikora vuba na bwangu nta kanda API.
webSearch.providerDesc: Gutoranya backend isubiza web_search na web_fetch.
webSearch.apiKeyOptional: Bitari ngombwa. Gutanga a {{provider}} API Urufunguzo kugirango igabanuka ry'ubushobozi n'ibisubizo byateguwe. Gusigara ubusa kugirango ukoreshe umurongo wa nyuma utagira urufunguzo.
webSearch.apiKeyRequired: Ni ngombwa. {{provider}} ikeneye urufunguzo API kugirango isubize ibisubizo.
webSearch.endpointDesc: Ishingiro URL ry'ikibazo cyawe {{provider}}, na JSON API ikora.

cowork.title: Cowork
cowork.description: Kugena imiterere y'umukoresha wa Cowork: shell ya sandbox, hamwe n'amarangamutima n'ubushobozi buhoraho mu bushyinguro bwa Novera bwa data.
cowork.shellSandboxed: Amabwiriza gukorwa ku {{backend}}:ishobora gusa kwandika hagati y'ubuso bwo gukoreramo ikiganiro, na amadosiye mu bushyinguro bwite ntibyasoma.
cowork.shellUnavailable: Sandbox ni Bihari ku iyi Sisitemu, kugirango i Igikoresho Bya Igikonoshwa ni OYA Byabonetse. Amabwiriza ni Buri gihe Gukora
cowork.networkDesc: Ifasha Cowork amabwiriza kugera ku resitora, kugirango ibintu nka Kwinjiza porogaramu cyangwa a resitora. Byakoreshejwe ku mburabuzi.
cowork.noMemories: Abamotari bashyiraho n'uburyo bwa memory_write ubwo bamenya ibintu bikwiye gushyirwa mu nyandiko.
cowork.noSkills: A skills ni urutonde rw'amabwiriza akoreshwa rimwe ashobora gukoreshwa na model ashobora gufungura ku bushake.
cowork.editMemoryDesc: Ingingo imwe ku nyandiko. Abahanga basoma izi nyandiko n'utwuma memory_read.
cowork.editSkillDesc: Markdown amabwiriza, n'ibisobanuro mu YAML frontmatter. Ibisobanuro ni ibyo abakinnyi babonye mbere yo gufungura ikoranabuhanga.
cowork.loadFailed: Ntabwo nashoboye gufungura ubuso bwo gukora bw'umukoresha

localApiServer.title: Seriveri ya API
localApiServer.serverLogsDesc: Reba amadosiye y'ibikubiyemo y'urubuga rwa API.
localApiServer.swaggerDocsDesc: Reba ibyemezo by'API byo gukoresha (Swagger UI).
localApiServer.runOnStartupDesc: Gutangira mu buryo bwikora ku buntu Seriveri API ubwo porogaramu yatangiraga.
localApiServer.runInBackgroundDesc: Kugirango i seriveri ikoreshejwe mu idirishya ry'idirishya rifunze. Ryari rihagaritswe, gufunga idirishya risohoka Novera rihagarika i seriveri.
localApiServer.serverPortDesc: Umubare wa port wa seriveri API.
localApiServer.apiKeyDesc: Gusuzuma ko ibyo ushaka bishoboka n'ufunguzo API.
localApiServer.trustedHostsDesc: Amatsinda yagenewe kwinjira muri seriveri, atandukanye n'amacomme.
localApiServer.corsDesc: Kwemera inyandiko ziturutse ahantu hatandukanye ku seriveri API.
localApiServer.verboseLogsDesc: Gukoresha inyandiko zigaragaza ibyakozwe na seriveri kugirango ukoreshe mu gusuzuma amakosa.
localApiServer.proxyTimeoutDesc: Igihe cyo gutegereza igisubizo cya model yo mu karere, mu masegonda.
localApiServer.defaultModelDesc: Modeli yo mu karere igomba gufungurwa igihe seriveri itangira.

privacy.helpUsImproveDesc: Ushobora kudufasha kunoza Novera, ushobora gusangiza amakuru atari yo nk'ikoreshwa ry'ibikorwa n'imibare y'abakoresha.Ntabwo dukusanya ikiganiro cyawe cyangwa amakuru yawe y'ibanga.
privacy.privacyPolicy: Ufite inshingano zo kugenzura amakuru yawe. Soma ibirenzeho muri Politiki yacu y’uburenganzira bwa muntu.
privacy.analyticsDesc: Mu rwego rwo kunoza Novera, dukeneye kumenya uko ikoreshwa, ariko tuzabigeraho gusa n'ubufasha bwawe.Ushobora guhindura iyi mikorere igihe cyose.
privacy.privacyPromises: Icyemezo cyawe hano kitazahindura amasezerano yacu y'ingenzi y'uburenganzira bwa muntu:
privacy.promise1: Ikiganiro cyawe gikomeza kuba cya gisirikari kandi kikaba kuri telefone yawe
privacy.promise2: Ntabwo dushobora gukusanya amakuru yawe y’ibanga cyangwa inyandiko z’ikiganiro.
privacy.promise3: Uko ukoresha urubuga: Uko ukoresha urubuga:
privacy.promise4: Ushobora guhagarika ikoreshwa ryazo igihe cyose ushaka, nta nkomyi
privacy.promise5: Dutanga amakuru asobanutse ku bijyanye n’ibyo dukusanya n’impamvu dukusanya

attachments.subtitle: Kugena imiterere y'inyandiko zishyinguyemo, imipaka y'ingano, n'imikorere y'ifungurwa ry'inyandiko.

attachments.chunkSizeDesc: Umubare mwinshi w'ayakarate ku chunk kugirango embeddings
